backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a courier service backend with access control, booking management, parcel tracking, status updates, and user profile management using stable storage maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five implemented UI features for the BookingSection form layout, mode selector, address fields, mobile verification button, and field label updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend components including App, hooks, pages, and UI components for the ML Enterprise courier service application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing authentication state, profile setup modal, conditional rendering of admin dashboard or public homepage, and global UI elements like theme provider and WhatsApp button.
frontend/src/components/BookingConfirmat: Dialog component displaying booking confirmation details with tracking number copy functionality and a button to open the shipping label modal.
frontend/src/components/BookingDetailsDi: Admin dialog for viewing complete booking details with status update form, tracking history timeline, and shipping label printing functionality.
frontend/src/components/BookingSection.t: Form component for creating new shipment bookings with fields for sender/receiver details, package info, pickup date/time, and shipping mode (ground/air). Validates pincode format, submits booking via mutation hook, and displays confirmation dialog on success.
frontend/src/components/BookingsTable.ts: Table component displaying all bookings with columns for booking ID, tracking number, sender/receiver, destination, status badges, and date. Includes view details action button that opens a dialog for selected booking.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact information section displaying ML Enterprise's address, phone, email, and business hours in card grid layout. Includes WhatsApp integration card with pre-filled message link.
frontend/src/components/CourierPartnersS: Section showcasing three courier partner logos (Delhivery, Blue Dart DHL, Everyday Express) in a responsive grid with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/DashboardStats.t: Dashboard statistics component displaying four metric cards: total bookings, queued, in transit, and delivered counts with color-coded icons.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with three columns: company info with logo, quick navigation links, and contact details. Includes copyright notice with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/GallerySection.t: Image gallery section displaying three operational photos in a grid with hover effects. Clicking an image opens a lightbox dialog for full-size viewing.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Main navigation header component with logo, desktop/mobile menus, smooth scrolling to sections, and Internet Identity authentication with user profile display.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero banner section displaying a full-width image with overlay gradient and call-to-action buttons for booking and tracking parcels.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time admin users to complete their profile with name, email, and phone number fields.
Displays three service tiers (Standard, Express, Overnight) with icons, delivery times, and feature lists in a card grid layout.
frontend/src/components/ShippingLabel.ts: Generates printable A6 shipping labels with barcode, booking details, sender/recipient info, and print/download functionality.
frontend/src/components/TrackingResult.t: Displays parcel tracking information including current status with icons/badges, booking details, and chronological tracking history.
Public-facing tracking section with search input form that queries parcels by tracking number and displays results using TrackingResult component.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppButton.t: Fixed floating button in bottom-right corner that opens WhatsApp chat with pre-filled message to business phone number.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous actor instance based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality, identity management, and status tracking through a React context provider.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including user profiles, bookings, parcel tracking, status updates, and admin role checks.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page displaying booking statistics and filterable tables for managing parcels by status (queued, in transit, delivered).
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page composing hero, services, courier partners, tracking, and contact sections.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme with OKLCH colors, container settings, border radius variables, and animation keyframes.
project_state.json: Project state file tracking 8 features for restructuring a booking form layout with two-column grid, mode selector toggle, address fields, mobile verification, and decorative elements. Includes image requirements for truck/airplane icons and package box illustrations.
